text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired: INC-789012 — service=rate-limiter-prod — symptom=spike in 429s from gateway (region: eu-west). PD link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-789012

pagerduty: Paging schedule: jess (primary), liam (backup). Incident assigned to jess.

jess: ack — I'm on it. Starting triage, will check quota-mapper, limiter health, and gateway traces. :mag:

mike: I can help with logs and k8s ops. Noticed a config push to `quota-mapper` ~13:02 UTC (internal CI run 2026-03-14T13:02:11Z). Pulling logs now.

anna: dashboards show 429 rate up to 22% for eu-west frontend pool. Error pattern looks like immediate rejects (no latency increase). Suspect quota mapping returning 0 limits.

jess: hitting health endpoints:
```
curl -sS https://quota-mapper.internal/eu-west/health
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
{"error":"panic: nil pointer deref in QuotaMapper"}
```

mike: logs from quota-mapper pod (snippet):
```
2026-03-14T13:02:12Z ERROR runtime: panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer deref
goroutine 47 [running]:
main.(*QuotaMapper).MapQuotas(...)
/opt/service/quota_mapper.go:214 +0x1a2
```
Looks like a bad config was loaded into runtime. CI rollout ID: r-2026-03-14-42.

liam: mitigation options:
- rollback quota-mapper to previous revision (safe).
- apply emergency default quota override (tenant default -> higher) to stop 429s while we rollback.
- route traffic for high-value tenants to dedicated pool `dedicated-eu-1`.
I can do the rollback and the override if someone confirms.

jess: do the rollback + override. Also open a temporary whitelist for top customers. Prioritize AcmeApp + BrightPay.

mike: running rollback:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/quota-mapper --to-revision=23
kubectl rollout status deployment/quota-mapper -n inference
# pod restart logs...
```
Deployment rolled back to rev 23 — pods restarted, new pods becoming ready.

mike: applied emergency config patch (set tenant_default_quota=10000):
```
kubectl patch configmap quota-config -n inference --type merge -p '{"data":{"tenant_default_quota":"10000"}}'
```

incident-bot: PD INC-789012 — note added: rollback started by mike; emergency override applied.

jess: monitoring: 429 rate dropping — eu-west 429% -> 0.6% over 6 minutes. :white_check_mark: Gateway errors for AcmeApp reduced.

olivia: customer-impact assessment:
- AcmeApp: saw 100% 429s from 13:02–13:23 UTC, approx 21 minutes. Support ticket created: S-4591.
- BrightPay: partial errors, spike ~30% for 12 minutes, incident notified.
- ~14 other tenants had transient rejects but auto-recovered after override.
We should prepare customer comms for AcmeApp (ops + CX).

jess: handing off to liam for follow-through and postmortem prep — I'm going offline in 15m. Handoff notes: rollback and override applied; need to capture pods/logs, preserve CI rollout artifacts, and run config validation job.

liam: ack — I'll own the postmortem and drive RCA. Next steps: collect logs (quota-mapper, gateway), CI deploy diff, and add a pre-deploy schema validation step for quota-config. Also will create a runbook entry for emergency override.

mike: submitted change to CI: add strict schema check for `quota-config.yaml` + canary rollout for quota-mapper. PR: https://git.example/r/quota-mapper/merge_requests/221

pagerduty: INC-789012 status updated -> resolved (mitigated) by jess/mike/liam at 2026-03-14T13:45:25Z.

jess: quick wins / action items assigned:
- liam: full postmortem + timeline + customer comms (due EOD next business day).
- mike: CI schema + canary rollout (PR opened).
- anna/olivia: correlate metrics and produce customer impact spreadsheet.
- SRE: add PD rule to include runbook link in page message.

jess: thanks everyone. Please add reactions if you were involved. :pray:

incident-bot: Add: reaction :white_check_mark: by jess, :eyes: by liam, :memo: by mike.
